developmentWindow.interaction: Computer Use on a visible Windows Electron development window

packagedArtifact.identityNote: File count and directory size match the Windows Electron artifact recorded in performance-baseline-2026-10-17.json. That report did not store the executable SHA-256, so exact binary identity with its samples is not proven.

packagedStartup.boundary: From Start-Process timestamp until Computer Use captured the activated package window showing the home page.

packagedRouteNavigation.entry: Command palette search followed by Return
packagedRouteNavigation.boundary: From Return-key dispatch until Computer Use captured the visible JSON minify page.
packagedRouteNavigation.result: The screenshot showed the JSON minify heading, sample input, and output.
packagedRouteNavigation.accessibilityNote: The accessibility tree in that capture still described the home route; route confirmation uses the screenshot.

packagedExit.boundary: From Alt+F4 dispatch until sky.list_windows reported no window for the packaged executable.

measurements.developmentWindowRestore: The TOML sample was cleared, the development app returned to its home route, and the pre-existing Sandbox proof window was restored to the foreground.

packagedBuildAttempt.target: A new temporary Windows x64 unpacked directory outside the repository.
packagedBuildAttempt.observation: electron-builder reached packaging but produced no output files for more than three minutes.
packagedBuildAttempt.cleanup: The build process was stopped. The existing release/win-unpacked directory was not changed.

limitations: Each packaged startup and route timing has one sample. Exit timing has two samples. These measurements include Computer Use window observation and are not comparable to the automated production baseline.
The measured package is version 2026.10.16-08de8e6, not the current modified source tree. Linux and macOS were not measured.
A fresh package build from the current source was stopped after electron-builder produced no output files for more than three minutes. The existing release directory was not changed.
Three isolated profile directories remain under the system temporary directory because automatic review rejected their recursive removal. No test process still uses them.
